deep.headline: The Focal Point.
deep.lede: Appointment only Consumer Retail occurs in "The Green Room". Appointment only Professional Retail occurs in "The Balcony". Every location is an R&D gold-mine; that we're in full control of.

sections.title: Front of House, Balcony, Green Room

items.title: Front of House
items.body: Exclusively focused on promoting the performing arts. Priority to local-regional culture and talent. Preferential ticket allocations split equally between supporters of the space and customers of the Green Room & Balcony. Donations 100% allocated to payment of local artists. **No sales floor. No clipboards.**
kv: a beautiful bar you'd find in any world-class city.

items.title: The Balcony
items.body: Built later or pre-existing — both acceptable. Focused on state-of-the-art production-capture and processing hardware and software. The inaugural home of AGF's l'Art Production line, plus submission-based integrations from live mixing techs (paid royalties). The seat from which the industry watches the next generation of pros become pros.
kv: SOTA studio, with a drink in your hand and a band downstairs.

items.title: The Green Room
items.body: The consumer retail space, deliberately *hidden*. You arrive through the venue, not through a glass storefront. Appointment-only access. The privilege of integration with the cool kids driving forward an endless flow of live performance art, at premium pricing, is the product.
list: Full AGF consumer line on display
Integrated with the surrounding live-performance context

items.body: Arrives at the bar. No sales floor. No clipboards. Sees a beautiful space that supports local culture.
Learns we're here. Through the act of being in a community, not through an ad.
Books an appointment. Like the original B&O. Like the original Birkin. Real, qualified, human.
Meets the Green Room. The consumer product, hidden, integrated, contextualized.
Becomes an owner. Or a venue partner. Or both. The platform scales from there.

sections.title: The target customer
sections.body: **Apple-loyal-recoveries-in-waiting** — sophisticated users who appreciate design and technology, who've been questioning the endless scroll, and would click immediately with a community locale that reflects their strengths *without being perceived as Big Brother*. The hard part. The whole point.

items.title: 50/50 in perpetuity
items.body: **50/50 in perpetuity** on every broadcast-mixed performance recorded at an AGF venue. Both parties co-own the broadcast master.

items.title: The artist's, full stop
items.body: The standard stereo capture and the on-site recording belong to the artist — full stop. They can sell it, mix it, master it, distribute it through any channel. AGF takes nothing.

items.title: Without cause
items.body: Artist retains the right to **block any subsequent broadcast by the venue, without cause**, even on the 50/50 broadcast-mixed version.

items.title: Front-running the outrage
items.body: Front-runs the inevitable open-source-advocate / big-tech-smear-campaign outrage by being the most artist-favorable contract in the industry.

sections.title: In the room without being in the room

items.title: Broadcast-mixed feed
items.body: Per-performance virtual ticket sales delivered via the broadcast-mixed feed. The fan watches the show as it happens — l'Art-encoded, owners-portal-grade — without being in the room. Owners get permanent virtual all-access included.

items.title: Artist-set, venue floor
items.body: Artist-set baseline with venue floor pricing. Revenue split 50/50 with the artist in perpetuity. AGF either provides the venue free or forfeits its share to the venue + artists when an owner uses their all-access pass.

items.title: Permanent all-access
items.body: AGF hardware owners receive a **permanent virtual all-access pass** to live content from every AGF venue, in perpetuity.

sections.title: Flagship only, one per market
sections.body:
**Flagship only — one per financially qualifying market.** The throwback with a new rhyme: real physical retail, real appointments, allergy to high-pressure tactics. The venue funds itself through the bar and ticketed performances; the Green Room is a high-margin appointment-driven retail surface, not a sales floor.

**One per financially qualifying market** — measured by the existing density of arts-aware sophisticated audio buyers, the local performing-arts ecosystem, and the availability of an owner-operator partner willing to host an AGF flagship under the FoH/Balcony/Green Room blueprint.
items: Ticketed live performance (donations 100% to local artists)
Balcony l'Art Production line installations + royalty-paid third-party submissions
Permanent virtual all-access pass — a perk bundled with hardware ownership

items.title: What it aligns with
items.body: Aligned with the **"movement to touch grass"** — the cultural backlash against the sterile, endless-scroll, Big-Brother-flavored boutique experience that Apple has worn out.

items.title: What it is not
items.body: Not a sterile glass-storefront boutique. Not a sales floor with clipboards. Not an algorithmically-personalized membrane. The venue resists every retail anti-pattern of the 2014–2026 era.

items.title: The stance
items.body: **Apple-loyal-recoveries-in-waiting** want a community locale that reflects their strengths — design literacy, technology fluency, cultural sophistication — *without* being surveilled. The Venue is that locale. Live performance is the brand surface; the consumer product is the secret you discover after you've decided you trust the room.
